newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $25 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Jan 6.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $25 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Jan 6.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $25 billion of three- and six-month bills on Jan 6 to pay down $2.775 billion as $27.781 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on Jan 9. The three-month bills mature on April 10 and the six-month bills mature on July 10.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127944E1 and for the six-month bills is 9127945F7.
